The National Federation of Women Living with HIV and AIDS (NFWLHA), was officially registered in 2007 with a vision to create a just and equitable society for women and children infected and affected with HIV, so that they can live a productive, empowered and dignified life, free from stigma and discrimination. Underpinned by guiding principles of gender equity and human rights, evidence-based planning, programming, and policy advocacy, NFWLHA has broadened its strategic intervention areas over the last nine years, focusing mainly on strengthening and capacity development of the network, knowledge management for evidence-based policy advocacy and community system strengthening. 

Currently, NFWLHA is implementing the Treatment, Care and Support Program in 25 districts across Koshi, Madhesh, and Bagmati Provinces with support from the Global Fund through UNDP. To support the effective implementation of this program, NFWLHA invites applications from qualified and motivated candidates for the following position:

Position: Admin/Finance Coordinator -1 (Treatment Care and Support Program)
